# Storyboard Studio

The native presentation compiler. Rust CLI and Tauri desktop turn Markdown and
structured briefs into reviewable stories and editable PowerPoint decks locally.

- [Documentation](https://othmaneblial.github.io/Storyboard-Studio/docs.html)
- [Source and contracts](https://github.com/OthmaneBlial/Storyboard-Studio)
- [Twenty synthetic native examples](https://github.com/OthmaneBlial/Storyboard-Studio/tree/main/gallery/native)

Offline compilation does not require a provider. Optional AI drafting requires
explicit transmission approval. Evidence presence and author confirmation do not
establish factual truth. Unsigned receipts verify internal consistency only.
